findings.evidence: Missing header: Strict-Transport-Security - HSTS - Forces HTTPS connections
Missing header: X-Content-Type-Options - Prevents MIME-type sniffing
Missing header: Content-Security-Policy - XSS and data injection protection
findings.remediation: Add a strict Content-Security-Policy header. Start with: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'

findings.evidence: Missing header: Referrer-Policy - Controls referrer information leakage
Missing header: Permissions-Policy - Controls browser features/APIs

findings.remediation: Configure server to suppress or genericize Server header

findings.evidence: POST form at https://www.google.com/v3/signin/identifier?continue=https://adsense.google.com/adsense/login?continue%3Dhttps://adsense.google.com/adsense/?utm_source%253Dabout.google%2526utm_medium%253Dreferral%2526utm_campaign%253Dproductslist&dsh=S1295342131:1788330724422147&flowEntry=ServiceLogin&flowName=WebLiteSignIn&followup=https://adsense.google.com/adsense/login?continue%3Dhttps://adsense.google.com/adsense/?utm_source%253Dabout.google%2526utm_medium%253Dreferral%2526utm_campaign%253Dproductslist&osid=1&service=adsense has no CSRF token field
findings.remediation: Add CSRF tokens to all state-changing forms. Use synchronizer token pattern or double-submit cookie. Implement SameSite cookies.
